name: VillaOS - Sync Google Sheets to Booking DB

parameters.query:
select id, owner_id, url, spreadsheet_id, title, parser_type, parser_config, color_mapping, last_synced_at
from sheets
where coalesce(sync_status, 'ok') <> 'disabled'
order by last_synced_at asc nulls first
limit 1;

with owner_upsert as (
  insert into owners(id, name)
  values ('{{$json.owner_id}}', '{{$json.owner_name}}')
  on conflict(id) do update set name = excluded.name
)
insert into properties(id, owner_id, name, area, address, bedrooms, capacity_standard, capacity_max, amenities, rules, images, base_price, extra_fee_note, source_sheet_id, source_sheet_url, description, map_url, last_synced_at)
values (
  '{{$json.property_id}}',
  '{{$json.owner_id}}',
  '{{$json.name_sql}}',
  nullif('{{$json.area}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.address_sql}}', ''),
  {{$json.bedrooms ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.capacity_standard ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.capacity_max ?? 'null'}},
  '{{$json.amenities_json}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.rules_json}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.images_json}}'::jsonb,
  {{$json.base_price ?? 'null'}},
  nullif('{{$json.extra_fee_note_sql}}', ''),
  '{{$json.source_sheet_id}}',
  nullif('{{$json.source_sheet_url_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.description_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.map_url_sql}}', ''),
  now()
)
on conflict (id) do update set
  name = excluded.name,
  owner_id = excluded.owner_id,
  address = coalesce(excluded.address, properties.address),
  capacity_standard = coalesce(excluded.capacity_standard, properties.capacity_standard),
  capacity_max = coalesce(excluded.capacity_max, properties.capacity_max),
  rules = excluded.rules,
  base_price = coalesce(excluded.base_price, properties.base_price),
  extra_fee_note = coalesce(excluded.extra_fee_note, properties.extra_fee_note),
  source_sheet_url = coalesce(excluded.source_sheet_url, properties.source_sheet_url),
  description = coalesce(excluded.description, properties.description),
  map_url = coalesce(excluded.map_url, properties.map_url),
  last_synced_at = now();

insert into availability_calendar(property_id, date, status, price, min_nights, note, source_sheet_id, source_updated_at, synced_at, confidence)
values (
  '{{$json.property_id}}',
  '{{$json.date}}'::date,
  '{{$json.status}}',
  {{$json.price ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.min_nights ?? 1}},
  nullif('{{$json.note_sql}}', ''),
  '{{$json.source_sheet_id}}',
  now(),
  now(),
  {{$json.confidence ?? 1}}
)
on conflict(property_id, date) do update set
  status = excluded.status,
  price = excluded.price,
  min_nights = excluded.min_nights,
  note = excluded.note,
  source_sheet_id = excluded.source_sheet_id,
  source_updated_at = now(),
  synced_at = now(),
  confidence = excluded.confidence;

insert into review_queue(id, property_id, date, raw_value, raw_color_hex, suggested_status, suggested_price, confidence, source_sheet_id, created_at, resolved)
values (
  '{{$json.review_id}}',
  '{{$json.property_id}}',
  '{{$json.date}}'::date,
  '{{$json.raw_value_sql}}',
  '{{$json.raw_color_hex}}',
  '{{$json.status}}',
  {{$json.price ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.confidence ?? 0}},
  '{{$json.source_sheet_id}}',
  now(),
  false
)
on conflict(id) do update set
  raw_value = excluded.raw_value,
  raw_color_hex = excluded.raw_color_hex,
  suggested_status = excluded.suggested_status,
  suggested_price = excluded.suggested_price,
  confidence = excluded.confidence,
  resolved = false;

with updated_sheet as (
  update sheets
  set sync_status = '{{$json.status}}',
      last_synced_at = now(),
      last_error = nullif('{{$json.error_sql}}', '')
  where id = '{{$json.sheet_id}}'
  returning id
)
insert into sync_logs(sheet_id, started_at, finished_at, status, rows_parsed, rows_review, error)
values (
  '{{$json.sheet_id}}',
  now(),
  now(),
  '{{$json.status}}',
  {{$json.rows_parsed ?? 0}},
  {{$json.rows_review ?? 0}},
  nullif('{{$json.error_sql}}', '')
);
